messages.subject: New instruction - effluent system dispute (Marldon)
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

We need to instruct you on a dispute. Our Walsall coatings subsidiary bought a bespoke membrane bioreactor effluent treatment system from Marldon Process Systems for £1.48m. It has never worked - eleven failures, lines down repeatedly. We terminated last month and have put in a replacement from Severnvale. Total losses are heading north of £2m.

Can we get a call in the diary this week? Robert Ellis (Ops Director) has all the technical history.

Richard

messages.subject: RE: New instruction - effluent system dispute (Marldon)
messages.plaintextBody:
Richard,

Happy to take this on. On the facts you describe this looks like a strong breach-of-contract / fitness-for-purpose claim, with the usual battleground being their standard-terms liability cap and any "you overloaded it" defence. I'm bringing in Tom Gallagher to run the day-to-day.

Thursday 2pm works our end. Please could Robert pull together the contract documents, the commissioning logs and the failure register before then.

Sarah Whitfield

Sarah Whitfield
